Updated Nov 12, 2026 06:09 IST

...

Gold Price Today, November 12: Gold slips below USD 4,000 for a third session as Fed rate hike bets rise. Silver falls 0.5 per cent to USD 51.47. (Image: Canva/ET Now)

Gold Price Today, November 12: Gold prices extended their decline for the third consecutive session on Thursday, slipping below the USD 4,000 mark as expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the December FOMC meeting weighed on bullion prices. Hotter-than-anticipated US inflation figures and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve policymakers boosted expectations of tighter monetary policy.

As of 5:50 am, spot gold (XAUUSD) was trading 0.2 per cent or USD 6 lower at USD 3,982.42. Prices were on track to register their third consecutive session of losses.

Spot silver (XAGUSD) was also under pressure, declining 0.5 per cent to trade at USD 51.47.

On the domestic front, gold and silver futures were not trading on the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) at the time of writing this report. However, the two precious metals had settled at Rs 1,39,730 per 10 grams and Rs 1,84,622 per kg, respectively.
